resources.string: DashboardSaver
Shows one web page, usually a dashboard, as this device\'s screensaver.
Page URL, for example https://example.com/dashboard
Other hosts the page may open, comma-separated (for a sign-in page on another host). *.example.com matches subdomains.
Reload every N minutes (0 = never)
Retry a failed load after N seconds
Zoom, percent (100 = the page\'s own size)
Let the screen dim
Shift the page slightly every 2 minutes (burn-in protection)
Interactive: the remote\'s arrows and OK work the page, Back asks the page first (other buttons end the screensaver)
